name: dice_roll_seeded
description: Dice notation (NdM+K, several terms, keep/drop highest or lowest, exploding dice, d%, Fudge dice): a reproducible roll with random.Random(seed) showing every die, and the exact probability distribution of the total by convolution in fractions, with mean, variance, mode and the chance of reaching a target.

seed.description: Roll with random.Random(seed); omit for no roll

target.description: Report P(total >= target) and P(total <= target)

explode_depth.description: Explosions per die kept in the table

catalog.source: original; the common tabletop dice notation (as in Roll20 and AnyDice); distributions by discrete convolution
